(a) Indomethacin
(b) Ketorolac
(c) Aspirin
(d) Celecoxib

questions.text: Enumerate hypolipidemic drugs. Write down the mechanism of action, clinical uses & adverse effects of statins.

1. Which of the following drugs would be best for treatment of an acute attack of asthma?
(a) Inhaled albuterol
(b) Oral albuterol
(c) Oral dexamethasone
(d) Oral salmeterol

2. A 24-year-old man is taking two medications to help with the symptoms of allergic rhinitis. He is noted to have a blood pressure of 150/70 mm Hg. The clinician notes that one of the medications may be responsible for the new-onset hypertension. The most likely aetiology is which of the following?
(a) Inhaled sodium cromoglycate
(b) Inhaled glucocorticoids
(c) Oral diphenhydramine
(d) Oral pseudoephedrine

3. A 60-year-old patient develops persistent muscle spasticity following a stroke. Which of the following drugs acts centrally by stimulating GABA-B receptors and can be used to reduce spasticity?
(a) Baclofen
(b) Dantrolene sodium
(c) Tizanidine
(d) Succinylcholine

4. Essential drug list is a:
(a) List of life saving drug
(b) List of drugs required for priority needs of population
(c) List of drugs by generic names
(d) List of drugs for common ailments

5. Which of following is contraindicated in patient with hyperkalaemia?
(a) Acetazolamide
(b) Chlorthalidone
(c) Ethacrynic acid
(d) Eplerenone
